resources.title: Who Is The Best Counter-Strike Team In History? (Vitality... or Astralis)
resources.creator: launders
resources.noteEs: launders abre el debate G.O.A.T. del CS competitivo: Vitality (era Donk + ZywOo + ropz) vs Astralis (era Device + dupreeh + glaive). 25 minutos de análisis comparativo de roster construction, dominance windows, achievements y por qué la conversación define la lectura del scene actual.
resources.noteEn: launders opens the G.O.A.T. debate in competitive CS: Vitality (Donk + ZywOo + ropz era) vs. Astralis (Device + dupreeh + glaive era). 25 minutes of comparative analysis covering roster construction, dominance windows, achievements, and why the conversation defines how to read the current scene.

resources.title: FURIA Are In Big Trouble
resources.creator: launders
resources.noteEs: Análisis editorial de launders sobre el momento crítico de FURIA en 2026: declive de resultados, problemas internos del roster y opciones realistas que tienen para revertir la situación. Honesto, sin filtros, perspectiva veterana del scene NA/SA.
resources.noteEn: Editorial analysis from launders on FURIA's critical moment in 2026: results decline, internal roster issues, and realistic options they have to turn it around. Honest, unfiltered, veteran perspective on the NA/SA scene.

resources.title: BEST MOMENTS of IEM Rio 2026 PLAYOFFS
resources.creator: ESL Counter-Strike
resources.noteEs: Highlights oficiales de los playoffs de IEM Rio 2026. 10 minutos curados directamente por el broadcaster del torneo — los plays que definieron quien avanzó, los clutches clave y las upsets más comentadas. Recurso de referencia para fans que se perdieron el live.
resources.noteEn: Official IEM Rio 2026 playoffs highlights. 10 minutes curated directly by the tournament broadcaster — the plays that decided who advanced, key clutches, and the most-discussed upsets. Reference resource for fans who missed the live.

resources.title: BEST MOMENTS of ESL Pro League Season 23 Playoffs
resources.creator: ESL Counter-Strike
resources.noteEs: 16 minutos de los plays más memorables del playoff de ESL Pro League S23 — el otro torneo tier-1 mensual del calendario, complementario al IEM. Cuando hay solapamiento, ambos definen rankings y posiciones para Majors.
resources.noteEn: 16 minutes of the most memorable plays from ESL Pro League S23 playoffs — the other tier-1 monthly tournament on the calendar, complementary to IEM. When they overlap, both define rankings and Major qualification slots.

resources.title: CAMBIOS en FaZe, MALBS SE VA de G2 & Na'Vi CAMPEON de la EPL
resources.creator: HDSuSo | CS2 Español
resources.noteEs: HDSuSo es de los pocos creators ES que mantienen cobertura consistente del esports CS2 en español. Este episodio cubre tres news mayores: rosters de FaZe, Malbsmd dejando G2, y NaVi como campeón de EPL. Anchor hispanohablante para esports CS competitivo.
resources.noteEn: HDSuSo is among the few ES creators with consistent Spanish CS2 esports coverage. This episode covers three major news items: FaZe rosters, Malbsmd leaving G2, and NaVi as EPL champion. Spanish-speaking anchor for competitive CS esports.
